Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Your offer cites market index increases as the basis for your pricing. Please provide your cost breakdown in XLSX format for negotiation of the individual elements; we do not accept price increases based on index movements that have not affected your actual costs.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 24 months, 189600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.79 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 24-month contract; option B: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 24-month contract; option C: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 24-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 908184 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We have verified the recent decrease in PPI-C2431 and factored this into our calculation.
While we do not share internal cost breakdowns, we can accommodate the 24-month term provided an AS-14404 index clause is applied.
Building on your third option, we propose €5.45 per unit with 14-day payment terms.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.45 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

You have revised your offer to reflect the verified index and volume changes and made the longer contract term conditional on an alloy surcharge index clause. We require a substantially lower base price in return for accepting such a clause, with a defined band within which no price adjustment applies.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 24 months, 189600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.97 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 24-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 942312 over the term.
3. Basis: Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
